data.rationale: Total Assets = Lending & Liquidity Assets + Other Assets
Lending & Liquidity Assets = Cash + Loans + Liquid Assets + Other
Deposits, Covered Bonds & Insurance Liabilities = Deposits & Debt + Accruals + Derivatives + Other
Total Equity = Share Capital, Reserves & AT1 + Retained Earnings + Fair Value Reserve
Liquidity Portfolio & Insurance Investments = Bank Liquidity Portfolio + Life Insurance Investments + Loans to Credit Institutions
Total Liabilities & Equity = Deposits & Funding + Other Liabilities + Equity
Fixed, Intangible & Other Assets = Equipment + Accum. Depreciation + Intangibles + Other
Subordinated Debt & Other Liabilities = Tier 2 + Tax + Provisions
Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Subordinated Debt + AT1 + Dividends
Cash Flow from Investing Activities = IT Investment + Disposals + Other

data.expression: SUM(cf-ni, cf-da, cf-dar, cf-dinv, cf-dap, cf-dwc)
data.rationale: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit + D&A + Balance Sheet Movements
Impairment of Credits (IFRS 9 ECL) = Stage 1/2 Movement + Stage 3 Impairments + Overlays
Depreciation & Amortisation = Equipment + Leases + IT Systems
Comparable Operating Profit = Pre-Depreciation Profit − D&A
Operating Margin % = Operating Profit / Operating Income x 100
Pre-Depreciation Profit = GP − Operating Expenses
Pre-Depreciation Margin % = Pre-Depreciation Profit / Operating Income x 100
Profit before Tax = Operating Profit + Other Items
Free Cash Flow = CFO + CapEx
Income after Credit Losses = Operating Income − Impairment of Credits
Income after Credit Losses % = GP / Operating Income x 100
Profit for the Period = PBT − Tax
Net Profit Margin % = Profit / Operating Income x 100
Items Affecting Comparability & Other = Associates + AT1 Interest + Other
Operating Expenses (excl. depreciation) = Distribution & Advisory + IT & Data + Group Functions
Total Operating Income = Interest, Commission & Insurance Income − Interest & Commission Expense
